pairs.source_text: What does Zur Einführung der transfiniten Zahlen (Acta Sci. Math. (Szeged) 1 (1923) 199) show?
pairs.target_text: 0 is the empty set and 1 = {0}: each ordinal is the set of those before it.

pairs.source_text: What does Untersuchungen über die Grundlagen der Mengenlehre I (Math. Ann. 65 (1908) 261) show?
pairs.target_text: Axiom II: there is an improper set, the null set 0, with no elements; Axiom VII: a set holding 0 and, with each a, the set {a}.

pairs.source_text: What does Die Grundlagen der Arithmetik (Koebner, Breslau, 1884) show?
pairs.target_text: 0 is the number of the concept 'not identical with itself', under which nothing falls; 1 is the number of the concept 'identical with 0'.

pairs.source_text: What does Was sind und was sollen die Zahlen? (Vieweg, Braunschweig, 1888) show?
pairs.target_text: The natural numbers as a simply infinite system, its base element written 1.

pairs.source_text: What does Laws of Form (Allen & Unwin, 1969) show?
pairs.target_text: A calculus built from one primitive act, drawing a distinction.

pairs.source_text: What does CODATA recommended values of the fundamental physical constants (NIST) show?
pairs.target_text: c, h, e and k_B are exact in the 2019 SI; G is measured; alpha is a pure number.

pairs.source_text: What does Über das Gesetz der Energieverteilung im Normalspectrum (Ann. Phys. 4 (1901) 553) show?
pairs.target_text: Planck's radiation law, after his December 1900 report to the German Physical Society.

pairs.source_text: What does The Cosmological Constants (Nature 139 (1937) 323) show?
pairs.target_text: The large-number coincidences between atomic and cosmic ratios.

pairs.source_text: What does Die Feldgleichungen der Gravitation (Sitzungsber. Preuss. Akad. Wiss. (1915) 844) show?
pairs.target_text: General relativity's field equations.

pairs.source_text: What does In what way does it become manifest in the fundamental laws of physics that space has three dimensions? (Proc. KNAW Amsterdam 20 (1917) 200) show?
pairs.target_text: Stable planetary orbits and atoms occur only in three space dimensions.

pairs.source_text: What does On the dimensionality of spacetime (Class. Quantum Grav. 14 (1997) L69) show?
pairs.target_text: Stability and predictability arguments single out 3 + 1 dimensions.

pairs.source_text: What does Zum Unitätsproblem der Physik (Sitzungsber. Preuss. Akad. Wiss. (1921) 966) show?
pairs.target_text: A fifth dimension unifying gravity and electromagnetism.

pairs.source_text: What does Quantentheorie und fünfdimensionale Relativitätstheorie (Z. Phys. 37 (1926) 895) show?
pairs.target_text: The fifth dimension compact and small.

pairs.source_text: What does Planck 2018 results. VI. Cosmological parameters (Astron. Astrophys. 641 (2020) A6) show?
pairs.target_text: The measured baryon density, giving a baryon-to-photon ratio near 6 x 10^-10.

pairs.source_text: What does Violation of CP invariance, C asymmetry, and baryon asymmetry of the universe (JETP Lett. 5 (1967) 24; reprinted Sov. Phys. Usp. 34 (1991) 392) show?
pairs.target_text: A baryon asymmetry can arise if baryon number is violated, C and CP are violated, and equilibrium is departed from.

pairs.source_text: What does A Collection of Papers which passed between the late Learned Mr. Leibnitz and Dr. Clarke (London, 1717 (letters of 1715-16)) show?
pairs.target_text: Leibniz: space is relations among things; shifting everything changes nothing real.

pairs.source_text: What does Philosophiae Naturalis Principia Mathematica: the Scholium to the Definitions (Motte's translation, 1729) (London, 1687; Motte's English translation, 1729) show?
pairs.target_text: Absolute space and time, against which relative space is a movable measure: the view Leibniz and Mach argue against.

pairs.source_text: What does Die Mechanik in ihrer Entwickelung (Brockhaus, Leipzig, 1883) show?
pairs.target_text: Inertia understood relative to the distant masses.

pairs.source_text: What does Gravitation und Elektrizität (Sitzungsber. Preuss. Akad. Wiss. (1918) 465) show?
pairs.target_text: Gauge invariance, first as a freedom of local scale.

pairs.source_text: What does Elektron und Gravitation (Z. Phys. 56 (1929) 330) show?
pairs.target_text: Gauge invariance as a freedom of local phase.

pairs.source_text: What does Quasi-particles and gauge invariance in the theory of superconductivity (Phys. Rev. 117 (1960) 648) show?
pairs.target_text: Spontaneous symmetry breaking in superconductivity.

pairs.source_text: What does Spontaneous symmetry breaking in particle physics: a case of cross fertilization (Nobel Lecture) (Nobel Lecture, 8 December 2008 (read by G. Jona-Lasinio)) show?
pairs.target_text: Nambu's own account: in spontaneous symmetry breaking the ground state has huge degeneracy, a symmetry operation takes one ground state to another, and only one of them, with its excited states, is realized.

pairs.source_text: What does Field theories with superconductor solutions (Nuovo Cimento 19 (1961) 154) show?
pairs.target_text: A broken continuous symmetry brings a massless boson.

pairs.source_text: What does Plasmons, gauge invariance, and mass (Phys. Rev. 130 (1963) 439) show?
pairs.target_text: In a gauge theory the would-be massless mode gives the gauge field mass.

pairs.source_text: What does Broken symmetry and the mass of gauge vector mesons (Phys. Rev. Lett. 13 (1964) 321) show?
pairs.target_text: Gauge bosons acquire mass through a broken symmetry.

pairs.source_text: What does Broken symmetries and the masses of gauge bosons (Phys. Rev. Lett. 13 (1964) 508) show?
pairs.target_text: The same mechanism, in which the Goldstone theorem fails for gauge fields, and its prediction of incomplete multiplets of scalar and vector bosons.

pairs.source_text: What does Global conservation laws and massless particles (Phys. Rev. Lett. 13 (1964) 585) show?
pairs.target_text: The third 1964 account of the mechanism.

pairs.source_text: What does Mémoire sur l'itération des fonctions rationnelles (J. Math. Pures Appl. 8 (1918) 47) show?
pairs.target_text: The iteration of rational maps of the complex plane.

pairs.source_text: What does Sur les équations fonctionnelles (Bull. Soc. Math. France 47-48 (1919-20)) show?
pairs.target_text: The same iteration, independently.

pairs.source_text: What does The Fractal Geometry of Nature (W. H. Freeman, 1982 (after Les objets fractals, 1975)) show?
pairs.target_text: Fractal geometry as a description of natural forms.

pairs.source_text: What does Quantitative universality for a class of nonlinear transformations (J. Stat. Phys. 19 (1978) 25) show?
pairs.target_text: Period doubling shares universal constants, delta about 4.669 and alpha about 2.503.

pairs.source_text: What does The spectral dimension of the universe is scale dependent (Phys. Rev. Lett. 95 (2005) 171301) show?
pairs.target_text: In causal dynamical triangulations the spectral dimension runs from about 4 to about 2 at short scales.

pairs.source_text: What does Renormalization group and critical phenomena (Phys. Rev. B 4 (1971) 3174 and 3184) show?
pairs.target_text: The renormalization group and its fixed points.

pairs.source_text: What does Statistical mechanics of cellular automata (Rev. Mod. Phys. 55 (1983) 601) show?
pairs.target_text: Elementary cellular automata and their classes of behaviour.

pairs.source_text: What does Universality in elementary cellular automata (Complex Systems 15 (2004) 1) show?
pairs.target_text: Rule 110 is computationally universal.

pairs.source_text: What does Thermodynamics of spacetime: the Einstein equation of state (Phys. Rev. Lett. 75 (1995) 1260) show?
pairs.target_text: Einstein's equation follows from dQ = T dS on local horizons with entropy proportional to area.

pairs.source_text: What does On the origin of gravity and the laws of Newton (JHEP 04 (2011) 029) show?
pairs.target_text: Gravity proposed as an entropic force.

pairs.source_text: What does Holographic derivation of entanglement entropy from AdS/CFT (Phys. Rev. Lett. 96 (2006) 181602) show?
pairs.target_text: In holographic theories, a region's entanglement entropy is a minimal bulk surface's area over 4G.

pairs.source_text: What does Building up spacetime with quantum entanglement (Gen. Rel. Grav. 42 (2010) 2323) show?
pairs.target_text: Removing entanglement between two regions pulls the spacetime between them apart.

pairs.source_text: What does Cool horizons for entangled black holes (Fortschr. Phys. 61 (2013) 781) show?
pairs.target_text: ER = EPR: the conjecture that entangled pairs are joined by non-traversable wormholes.

pairs.source_text: What does On the attraction between two perfectly conducting plates (Proc. KNAW 51 (1948) 793) show?
pairs.target_text: Two uncharged plates attract: an effect of the vacuum's modes.

pairs.source_text: What does Ueber irreversible Strahlungsvorgänge (Ann. Phys. 1 (1900) 69) show?
pairs.target_text: §26, natural units: units of length, mass, time and temperature from his two radiation constants, c and the gravitational constant, meaningful for all times and cultures.

pairs.source_text: What does Thermodynamik und spezifische Wärme (Sitzungsber. Preuss. Akad. Wiss. (1912) 134) show?
pairs.target_text: The unattainability principle: no change of matter reaches absolute zero from any temperature, however low.

pairs.source_text: What does Eine neue Strahlungshypothese (Verh. Dtsch. Phys. Ges. 13 (1911) 138) show?
pairs.target_text: The second theory: an oscillator's mean energy is the earlier value plus the constant hν/2.

pairs.source_text: What does Einige Argumente für die Annahme einer molekularen Agitation beim absoluten Nullpunkt (Ann. Phys. 40 (1913) 551) show?
pairs.target_text: Arguments for a zero-point energy, from the specific heat of hydrogen and a derivation of Planck's law.

pairs.source_text: What does Über die Berechnung chemischer Gleichgewichte aus thermischen Messungen (Nachr. Ges. Wiss. Göttingen (1906) 1) show?
pairs.target_text: The heat theorem, as a hypothesis about maximal work and energy near absolute zero.

pairs.source_text: What does Gravitational collapse and space-time singularities (Phys. Rev. Lett. 14 (1965) 57) show?
pairs.target_text: Under general conditions gravitational collapse ends in a singularity.

pairs.source_text: What does A mathematical theory of communication (Bell Syst. Tech. J. 27 (1948) 379) show?
pairs.target_text: Information as a measurable quantity; the limits of compression.

pairs.source_text: What does A formal theory of inductive inference, part I (Information and Control 7 (1964) 1) show?
pairs.target_text: Induction as finding the shortest program that produces the data.

pairs.source_text: What does The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (ICML 2024) show?
pairs.target_text: Evidence that larger models' representations grow more alike, and the hypothesis that they converge on a shared model of reality.

pairs.source_text: What does Willow kernel.py (willow-memory/Willow) show?
pairs.target_text: Serves passages with file and line only when they hold half a question's words; an append-only hash chain whose root is the zero hash; the boot row is numbered 0.
